D001.text: So much is growing here. Light, and food. Enough for a generation.

C002.text: Three falls. You begin the descent again from the outpost door.

C003.text: The deep ways go down before they go west. Walk to the end of each ledge and step down.

C005.text: The deep ways. Keep west. Some ways end in stone; turn back and try another.

C006.text: The way is walled. A shaft climbs into the dark. Jump for the ledges and pull yourself up.

C007.text: Over the wall. The deep ways go on, west.

D003.text: Carry it carefully. Tell your father I asked after him.

D004.text: Hail! You are from the outpost on the far road? Your father keeps it?

D005.text: He does. He sent me for the Rite and the light.

D006.text: And how does the outpost fare? The water, the stores?

D007.text: The water runs clean and pure, But the stores are thinning...

D008.text: We will send what we can.

D009.text: But I will be honest with you, the Assembly's own stores are beginning to run low as well.

D010.text: Go on. They are gathering for the rite.

D011.text: Back again I see. How is the outpost?

D012.text: My father sends word: our stores are nearly gone.

D013.text: We will help however we can. But I need his counsel.

D014.text: Tell him the whole community is struggling for food now, not only the outposts. I would welcome his council.

D016.text: Go on. They are waiting for you.

D017.text: Veyra, go to the Assembly, and bring back the light for our household.

D018.text: The road is long. Keep to the stone, and come home to us.

D019.text: The light is failing again. Go to the Assembly, and bring back the light for our household.

D020.text: And carry a message to Torven, at the Assembly: our stores are running low.

D021.text: Tell Torven that I have thought long on his query, alas only the stone remains. Our stores are all but gone now. Go quickly, and bring back the light.

D022.text: You came by the deep ways? No one has come that way in a generation.

D023.text: The cave on the East road has fallen in. And our stores are all but gone.

D024.text: But on the deep way, before the old shaft, there is a chamber full of living light. Growing things, more than anyone could eat.

D026.text: Then you have saved us. All of us, Veyra.

D027.text: We will send a party to clear your road, and another to that chamber. Stores will go back with you.

D028.text: Take your place in the rite. After today, everyone here will know your name.

C008.text: Take your place in the rite.

C009.text: Three falls. You begin the deep ways again from the foot of the long descent.

C010.text: Three falls. You wake where you took the light.

C011.text: Three falls. You begin again from the outpost.

D029.text: The gatekeeper sees the light you carry.

C012.text: Carry the light home. Far back on the road, a bell door has fallen shut.

D030.text: Veyra. The party will not have your road open before morning.

D031.text: Eat with us tonight. Mira will not forgive me if I let you sleep on the hall floor.

D032.text: Sit, sit. Torven says you walked the deep ways alone.

D033.text: Most of the way. Some passages ended in stone, and I had to turn back.

D035.text: A few. They mostly wanted the light.

D036.text: Before we eat, the children sing the blessing. The guest answers it.

D037.text: You have to sing it back. Exactly.

D039.text: We cooked what you carried up from the chamber. Everyone at this table should taste what saved them.

D043.text: He keeps the outpost alone now. I will be home tomorrow.

D044.text: Tomorrow, then. Rest here tonight. The road will be clear by morning.

D045.text: Close enough. They will teach it to you properly next time.

P001.text: Sing the blessing back: keys 1 to 7

C013.text: Morning. The road home is clear. Far back on it, a bell door has fallen shut.

C014.text: The deep cave. The roof hangs low in places.

D046.text: The roof of the cave has come down. Broken stone fills the way.

D047.text: The road is shut. I have to tell my father.

D048.text: The cave has fallen in. The road to the Assembly is shut.

D049.text: Then there is only the old road, west, through the deep ways. It is long, treacherous, and no one from here has walked it in years.

D050.text: The stores will not last until someone clears that cave. Take this map. Find the Assembly, tell them what has happened, and bring back the light.

C016.text: Go west, through the door behind the outpost.

D051.text: Torven asks for your counsel. He says the whole community is struggling for food.

D052.text: Then it is not only us.

D053.text: Rest now. I will think on what to tell him.

D054.text: You came back. And with stores.

D055.text: Rest now. The light is home, and so are you.

D056.text: You have brought the light home.

P003.text: Stand in the light. The rite begins.

P004.text: Hold E as the light rises · release as it falls

P005.text: This bell is silent this cycle.

P006.text: E strike · Q turn the bell

P010.text: Go back to the outpost and tell your father.

P011.text: Go west, through the door behind the outpost.

P012.text: Walk back into the hall, to the circle of light.

P013.text: Bring the light to your father.

P014.text: Carry the light home to the outpost.

P016.text: Space to jump · hold for height

P018.text: The gatekeeper will open the way.

P019.text: Read the wall. Ring the bells so they answer one another.

P022.text: Step into the circle of light.

C017.text: You know this road. There is no map for it.
